# jumpcloud_ip_list (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud IP list, a named set of addresses that `jumpcloud_authentication_policy` conditions refer to with `ipAddressIn`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_ip_list" "office" {
  name        = "office"
  description = "Office egress addresses"
  ips         = ["203.0.113.7", "198.51.100.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ips` (Set of String) IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and CIDR ranges, such as `203.0.113.7` or `198.51.100.0/24`.
- `name` (String) IP list name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) IP list description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) IP list ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID.
terraform import jumpcloud_ip_list.office 5f0c1b2a3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d
```
